what: A Smart Explorer for SDTM and ADaM Clinical Trial Datasets
title: A Smart Explorer for SDTM and ADaM Clinical Trial Datasets
text: databoxR Shiny-based R package provides Windows Explorer-style interface browsing SDTM ADaM datasets. ’s designed clinical data scientists, biostatisticians, reviewers want explore datasets, metadata, content interactively.

title: A Smart Explorer for SDTM and ADaM Clinical Trial Datasets
text: 📁 File Management: Upload select multiple SDTM/ADaM files (XPT, CSV, TXT formats) 👁️ Dataset Preview: Interactive tables filtering, searching, variable information 🧾 Metadata Explorer: Variable labels, data dictionary, CDISC compliance checks 📊 Exploratory Data Analysis: Distributions, correlations, missing data patterns 🧑‍⚕️ Subject Profile: Follow one subject (USUBJID) across every loaded domain cross-domain timeline, KPI cards, highlighted adverse events 📈 Interactive Visualizations: Histograms, boxplots, density plots, correlation matrices 🔍 Data Quality Assessment: Missing data analysis, duplicate detection, constant variables 📤 Export Functionality: Download filtered datasets analysis results 🧪 Demo Mode: Built-sample datasets immediate exploration

text: Professional Tab Styling: Enhanced tab appearance gradient backgrounds, proper padding, visual separation Interactive Visualizations: charts now use plotly better interactivity responsiveness Margin Issues: Eliminated “figure margins large” errors migrating plotly Consistent Spacing: Proper 10px gaps icons text, 12px margins tabs Modern Card Design: Enhanced card layouts Bootstrap styling shadows

title: databoxR 0.1.1
